name: HC10e2: Diagnosed with CCM
description: Number of new ART clients with baseline CD4 <200 diagnosed with Cryptococcal Meningitis (CCM) - Requires clinical documentation
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
configJson: {"version": 1, "themeUuid": "fce32056-826f-11f1-b08c-f4053e2709b9", "conditions": [], "sqlPreview": "PLACEHOLDER - Requires clinical documentation field for CCM diagnosis", "themeConfig": {"sourceTable": "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card", "patientIdColumn": "client_id", "dateColumn": "encounter_date"}}
sqlTemplate:
WITH new_art_cd4_lt200 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.client_id, s.baseline_regimen_start_date
  FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
  WHERE s.baseline_regimen_start_date >= DATE_FORMAT(:endDate, '%Y-%m-01') 
    AND s.baseline_regimen_start_date < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(:endDate, '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
    AND s.baseline_cd4 IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(s.baseline_cd4 AS UNSIGNED) < 200
    AND (:location IS NULL OR s.location_id = :location)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT art.client_id) AS total
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card art
INNER JOIN new_art_cd4_lt200 n ON art.client_id = n.client_id
WHERE art.encounter_date >= DATE_FORMAT(:endDate, '%Y-%m-01') 
  AND art.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(:endDate, '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
  AND art.crag_test_results = "Positive"
  AND (:location IS NULL OR art.location_id = :location);
